tools.name: orderbook_imbalance
tools.description: Aggregates spot order book depth and returns bid/ask notional within 10/25/50/100 bps of mid, signed imbalance in [-1,1], largest liquidity walls and a directional signal. First 3 calls per day free, then 0.02 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: token_audit
tools.description: Rug-pull / honeypot check before you buy a token. Inspects mint and freeze authority, token-2022 extensions, proxy and ownership state, privileged functions and top holder concentration. Returns a 0-100 risk score with itemised flags. First 3 calls per day free, then 0.20 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: swap_quote_and_build
tools.description: Free to call. Returns the best route and an unsigned transaction, and for Solana swaps a rug-pull risk check of the output token (mint/freeze authority, token-2022 traps, holder concentration) so agents do not buy honeypots. Same-chain Solana swaps route through Jupiter with a referral fee account.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "orderbook_imbalance" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
